G400.b:
⟪ἀνα-φωνέω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX for ⁨שׁמע⁩ hi., ⁨זכר⁩ hi.;] ⟪to cry out⟫, ⟪exclaim⟫: ⟦Luke 1:42|Lk 1:42⟧ (Arist., al.).†

G401.b:
*† ⟪ἀνά-χυσις⟫, -εως, ἡ
(< ἀναχέω, to pour out), ⟪a pouring out⟫, ⟪overflowing⟫, ⟪excess⟫: metaph., ⟦1 Peter 4:4|I Pe 4:4⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G402.b:
⟪ἀνα-χωρέω⟫, -ῶ,
[in LXX for ⁨בּרח⁩, ⁨נוּם⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to go back⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to withdraw⟫: ⟦Matthew 9:24|Mt 9:24⟧; freq. in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟦Matthew 2:12|Mt 2:12⟧ (but v. Thayer), ⟦Matthew 2:13|13⟧, ⟦Matthew 2:14|14⟧, ⟦Matthew 2:22|22⟧ ⟦Matthew 4:12|4:12⟧ ⟦Matthew 12:15|12:15⟧ ⟦Matthew 14:13|14:13⟧ ⟦Matthew 15:21|15:21⟧ ⟦Matthew 27:5|27:5⟧, ⟦Mark 3:7|Mk 3:7⟧, ⟦John 6:15|Jo 6:15⟧, ⟦Acts 23:19|Ac 23:19⟧ ⟦Acts 26:31|26:31⟧.†

G404.b:
⟪ἀνα-ψύχω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨נפשׁ⁩ ni., ⁨חיה⁩, etc. (freq. in sense of revive, refresh oneself);] ⟪to refresh⟫: c. acc. pers., ⟦2 Timothy 1:16|II Ti 1:16⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.; Cremer, 588).†
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G405.b:
* ⟪ἀνδραποδιστής⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war), ⟪a slave-dealer⟫, ⟪kidnapper⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 1:10|I Ti 1:10⟧ (v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G407.b:
⟪ἀνδρίζω⟫,
[in LXX for ⁨חזק⁩, ⁨אמץ⁩ (⟦Joshua 1:6|Jos 1:6⟧ ff., ⟦1 Chronicles 22:19|I Ch 22:19⟧, al.; in ⟦2 Samuel 10:12|II Ki 10:12⟧, ⟦Psalms 27:14|Ps 27:14⟧ ⟦Psalms 31:25|31:25⟧ combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in ⟦1 Corinthians 16:13|I Co 16:13⟧);] ⟪to make a man of⟫. Mid., ⟪to play the man⟫ (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦1 Corinthians 16:13|I Co 16:13⟧.†

G409.b:
** ⟪ἀνδρο-φόνος⟫, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX: II Mac 9:28*;] ⟪a man-slayer⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 1:9|I Ti 1:9⟧ (cf. φονεύς, and v. MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G410.b:
** ⟪ἀν-έγκλητος⟫, -ον
(< ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: III Mac 5:31*;] ⟪not to be called to account⟫, ⟪unreprovable⟫: ⟦1 Corinthians 1:8|I Co 1:8⟧, ⟦Colossians 1:22|Col 1:22⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 3:10|I Ti 3:10⟧, ⟦Titus 1:6|Tit 1:6⟧, ⟦Titus 1:7|7⟧.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ὀνεπίλημπτος (v. Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, s.v.).
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886
Synonyms of the N. T. , by R. C. Trench. Ninth Edition. Macmillan, 1880

G411.b:
*† ⟪ἀν-εκδιήγητος⟫, -ον
(< ἀ-, ἐκδιηγέομαι), ⟪inexpressible⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 9:15|II Co 9:15⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G416.b:
*† ⟪ἀνεμίζω⟫ = Attic ἀνεμόω
(< ἄνεμος); pass., ⟪to be driven by the wind⟫: ⟦James 1:6|Ja 1:6⟧.†

G417.b:
⟪ἄνεμος⟫, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for ⁨רוּחַ⁩;] ⟪wind⟫: ⟦Matthew 11:7|Mt 11:7⟧ ⟦Matthew 14:24|14:24⟧, ⟦Matthew 14:30|30⟧, ⟦Matthew 14:32|32⟧, ⟦Mark 4:37|Mk 4:37⟧, ⟦Mark 4:39|39⟧, ⟦Mark 4:41|41⟧ ⟦Mark 6:48|6:48⟧, ⟦Mark 6:51|51⟧, ⟦Luke 7:24|Lk 7:24⟧ ⟦Luke 8:23|8:23⟧, ⟦Luke 8:24|24⟧, ⟦John 6:13|Jo 6:13⟧, ⟦Acts 27:7|Ac 27:7⟧, ⟦Acts 27:14|14⟧, ⟦Acts 27:15|15⟧, ⟦James 3:4|Ja 3:4⟧, ⟦Revelation 6:13|Re 6:13⟧ ⟦Revelation 7:1|7:1⟧; pl., ⟦Matthew 7:25|Mt 7:25⟧, ⟦Matthew 7:27|27⟧ ⟦Matthew 8:26|8:26⟧, ⟦Matthew 8:27|27⟧, ⟦Luke 8:25|Lk 8:25⟧, ⟦Acts 27:4|Ac 27:4⟧, ⟦Jude 1:12|Ju 12⟧; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, ⟦Revelation 7:1|Re 7:1⟧; hence the four quarters of the heavens (v. Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟦Matthew 24:31|Mt 24:31⟧, ⟦Mark 13:27|Mk 13:27⟧; metaph., of variable teaching, ⟦Ephesians 4:14|Eph 4:14⟧.†
SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ).
a: Bible Studies, by G. A. Deissmann. Second English Edition, including Bibelstudien and Neue Bibelstudien, tr. by A. Grieve. T. & T. Clark, 1909

G419.b:
** ⟪ἀνεξεραύνητος⟫
(Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (< ἐξ-ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): ⟦Proverbs 25:3|Pr., 25:3⟧*;] ⟪unsearchable⟫: ⟦Romans 11:33|Ro 11:33⟧.†
a: A Grammar of N.T. Greek. Vol. I, Prolegomena, by J. H. Moulton. Third Edition. Scribners, 1908

G420.b:
*† ⟪ἀνεξί-κακος⟫, -ον
(< fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός), ⟪patiently forbearing⟫ (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wi 2:19; and v. MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦2 Timothy 2:24|II Ti 2:24⟧.†

G421.b:
† ⟪ἀνεξιχνίαστος⟫, -ον
(< ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; < ἴχνος), [in LXX: ⟦Job 5:9|Jb 5:9⟧ ⟦Job 9:10|9:10⟧ ⟦Job 34:24|34:24⟧ (⁨חֵקֶר⁩ ⁨אֵין⁩)*;] ⟪that cannot be traced out⟫: ⟦Romans 11:33|Ro 11:33⟧, ⟦Ephesians 3:8|Eph 3:8⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G422.b:
*† ⟪ἀν-επ-αίσχυντος⟫, -ον
(< ἐπαισχύνομαι), ⟪not to be put to shame⟫: ⟦2 Timothy 2:15|II Ti 2:15⟧.†

G423.b:
* ⟪ἀν-επί-λημπτος⟫ (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον
(< ἀ-, ἐπιλαμβάνω), ⟪without reproach⟫: ⟦1 Timothy 3:2|I Ti 3:2⟧ ⟦1 Timothy 5:7|5:7⟧ ⟦1 Timothy 6:14|6:14⟧.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).

G424.b:
⟪ἀν-έρχομαι⟫,
[in LXX: ⟦1 Kings 13:12|III Ki 13:12⟧ (⁨הָלַךְ⁩)*;] ⟪to go up⟫: ⟦John 6:3|Jo 6:3⟧, ⟦Galatians 1:17|Ga 1:17⟧, ⟦Galatians 1:18|18⟧ (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up" to the capital, MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G425.b:
⟪ἄνεσις⟫, -εως, ἡ,
(< ἀνίημι), [in LXX: II Es 4:22 (⁨שָׁלוּ⁩), ⟦2 Chronicles 23:15|II Ch 23:15⟧, I Es 4:62, Wi 13:13, Si 15:20 26:10*;] ⟪a loosening, relaxation⟫: ⟦Acts 24:23|Ac 24:23⟧ (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, s.v.); by St. Paul, opp. to θλίψις, expressed or understood, ⟪relief⟫: ⟦2 Corinthians 2:12|II Co 2:12⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 7:5|7:5⟧ ⟦2 Corinthians 8:13|8:13⟧, ⟦2 Thessalonians 1:7|II Th 1:7⟧.†
SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (q.v.).†

G426.b:
† ⟪ἀν-ετάζω⟫
(< ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; v. MM, VGT, s.v.), [in LXX: ⟦Judges 6:29|Jg 6:29⟧ (⁨דָּרַשׁ⁩), ⟦Ezra 2:23|Es 2:23⟧ (⁨בָּקַשׁ⁩), Da TH Su 14*;] ⟪to examine judicially⟫: ⟦Acts 22:24|Ac 22:24⟧, ⟦Acts 22:29|29⟧.†

G427.b:
⟪ἄνευ⟫,
prep. c. gen. (rarer than χωρίς, q.v.; cf. Ellic. on ⟦Ephesians 2:12|Eph 2:12⟧; MM, VGT, 42), ⟪without⟫: ⟦Matthew 10:29|Mt 10:29⟧, ⟦1 Peter 3:1|I Pe 3:1⟧ ⟦1 Peter 4:9|4:9⟧.†
a: Commentary on St. Paul's Epistles, by C. J. Ellicott. Andover, 1860-65

G428.b:
*† ⟪ἀν-εύ-θετος⟫, -ον
(v. MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟪not well placed⟫, ⟪not fit⟫: ⟦Acts 27:12|Ac 27:12⟧.†

G429.b:
** ⟪ἀν-ευρίσκω⟫
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: IV Mac 3:14*;] ⟪to find out⟫ by search, ⟪discover⟫ (v. Field, Notes, 47 f.): ⟦Luke 2:16|Lk 2:16⟧, ⟦Acts 21:4|Ac 21:4⟧.†
a: Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G430.b:
⟪ἀν-έχω⟫,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨אפק⁩ hithp.;] ⟪to hold up⟫; in NT always mid., ⟪to bear with⟫, ⟪endure⟫: in cl. most freq. c. acc., but in NT c. gen. pers., ⟦Matthew 17:17|Mt 17:17⟧, ⟦Mark 9:19|Mk 9:19⟧, ⟦Luke 9:41|Lk 9:41⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:1|II Co 11:1⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:19|19⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:2|Eph 4:2⟧, ⟦Colossians 3:13|Col 3:13⟧; seq. μικρόν τι, c. gen. pers. and c. gen. rei, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:1|II Co 11:1⟧; c. dat. rei, ⟦2 Thessalonians 1:4|II Th 1:4⟧ (v M, Th., in l.); seq. εἴ τις, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:20|II Co 11:20⟧; absol., ⟦1 Corinthians 4:12|I Co 4:12⟧, ⟦2 Corinthians 11:4|II Co 11:4⟧; ⟪to bear with⟫ = ⟪to listen to⟫, c. gen. pers., ⟦Acts 18:14|Ac 18:14⟧; c. gen. rei, ⟦2 Timothy 4:3|II Ti 4:3⟧, ⟦Hebrews 13:22|He 13:22⟧ (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, s.v.).†
a: St. Paul's Epistles to the Thessalonians, by G. Milligan. Macmillan, 1908

G431.b:
⟪ἀνεψιός⟫, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: ⟦Numbers 36:11|Nu 36:11⟧ (⁨דּוֹד⁩ ⁨בֶּן⁩), To 7:2 9:6 ⁨א⁩*;] ⟪a cousin⟫: ⟦Colossians 4:10|Col 4:10⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.).†

G433.b:
⟪ἀν-ήκω⟫
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: ⟦Joshua 23:14|Jos 23:14⟧ (⁨בּוֹא⁩), ⟦1 Samuel 27:8|I Ki 27:8⟧, Si. prol. 10, I, II Mac6*;] prop., ⟪to have come up to⟫; in later writers, impers. ⟪it is due⟫, ⟪it is befitting⟫: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, s.v.), ⟦Ephesians 5:4|Eph 5:4⟧, ⟦Colossians 3:18|Col 3:18⟧; τὸ ἀνῆκον, ⟦Philemon 1:8|Phm 8⟧.†

G434.b:
* ⟪ἀν-ήμερος⟫, -ον
(ἀ-, ἥμερο), ⟪not tame⟫, ⟪savage⟫ (MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦2 Timothy 3:3|II Ti 3:3⟧.†

G435.b:
⟪ἀνήρ⟫, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨אִישׁ⁩, freq. ⁨אֱנוֹשׁ⁩, also ⁨אָדָם⁩, etc.;] ⟪a man⟫, Lat. vir.
⟪1.⟫ As opp. to a woman, ⟦Acts 8:12|Ac 8:12⟧, ⟦1 Timothy 2:12|I Ti 2:12⟧; as a ⟪husband⟫, ⟦Matthew 1:16|Mt 1:16⟧, ⟦John 4:16|Jo 4:16⟧, ⟦Romans 7:2|Ro 7:2⟧, ⟦Titus 1:6|Tit 1:6⟧.
⟪2.⟫ As opp. to a boy or infant, ⟦1 Corinthians 13:11|I Co 13:11⟧, ⟦Ephesians 4:13|Eph 4:13⟧, ⟦James 3:2|Ja 3:2⟧.
⟪3.⟫ In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, ⟦Luke 5:8|Lk 5:8⟧; ἀ. προφήτης, ⟦Luke 24:19|24:19⟧; freq. in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, ⟦Acts 1:16|Ac 1:16⟧; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, ⟦Acts 22:3|Ac 22:3⟧; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, ⟦Acts 19:35|19:35⟧.
⟪4.⟫ In general, ⟪a man⟫, ⟪a male person⟫: = τις, ⟦Luke 8:41|Lk 8:41⟧, ⟦Acts 6:11|Ac 6:11⟧.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, q.v. (cf. MM, VGT, s.v.).

G436.b:
⟪ἀνθ-ίστημι⟫
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for ⁨עמד⁩, ⁨יצב⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, ⟪to set against⟫.
⟪2.⟫ In mid. and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., ⟪to withstand⟫, ⟪resist⟫, ⟪oppose⟫: c. dat., ⟦Matthew 5:39|Mt 5:39⟧, ⟦Luke 21:15|Lk 21:15⟧, ⟦Acts 6:10|Ac 6:10⟧ ⟦Acts 13:8|13:8⟧, ⟦Romans 9:19|Ro 9:19⟧ ⟦Romans 13:2|13:2⟧, ⟦Galatians 2:11|Ga 2:11⟧, ⟦Ephesians 6:13|Eph 6:13⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 3:8|II Ti 3:8⟧ ⟦2 Timothy 4:15|4:15⟧, ⟦James 4:7|Ja 4:7⟧, ⟦1 Peter 5:9|I Pe 5:9⟧.†

G437.b:
⟪ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι⟫, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 79:13|Ps 78 (79):13⟧ (⁨יָדָה⁩), ⟦Daniel 4:34|Da LXX 4:34⟧ (⁨שְׁבַּח⁩), I Es 8:91, Si 20:2, III Mac 6:33*;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to make a mutual agreement⟫ (Dem., Polyb.).
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to acknowledge fully⟫, ⟪confess⟫ (Diod., Polyb., cf. I Es 8:91).
⟪3.⟫ C. dat. pers., ⟪to declare one's praises⟫, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, ⟪give thanks to⟫ (cf. ⟦Psalms 79:13|Ps 78 (79):13⟧): ⟦Luke 2:38|Lk 2:38⟧ (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, s.v.).†
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G438.b:
⟪ἄνθος⟫, -εος, τό,
[in LXX for ⁨צִיץ⁩, etc.;] ⟪a flower⟫: ⟦James 1:10|Ja 1:10⟧, ⟦James 1:11|11⟧, ⟦1 Peter 1:24|I Pe 1:24⟧(LXX).†

G439.b:
** ⟪ἀνθρακιά⟫, -ᾶς, ἡ
(< ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Si 11:32, IV Mac 9:20*;] ⟪a heap of burning coals⟫: ⟦John 18:18|Jo 18:18⟧ ⟦John 21:9|21:9⟧.†

G440.b:
⟪ἄνθραξ⟫, -ακος, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨גַּחֶלֶת⁩;] ⟪coal⟫, ⟪charcoal⟫: . ἄ. πυρός, ⟪a burning coal⟫, ⟦Romans 12:20|Ro 12:20⟧.†

G441.b:
† ⟪ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος⟫, -ον
(ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: ⟦Psalms 53:5|Ps 52 (53):5⟧*;] ⟪studying to please men⟫: ⟦Ephesians 6:6|Eph 6:6⟧, ⟦Colossians 3:22|Col 3:22⟧ (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, s.v.).†
a: Biblico-Theological Lexicon of N.T. Greek, by H. Cremer. Third English Edition, with Supplement. T. & T. Clark, 1886

G442.b:
⟪ἀνθρώπινος⟫, -η, ον
(< ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for ⁨אָדָם⁩, ⁨אֱנוֹשׁ⁩;] ⟪human⟫, belonging to man: χεῖρες, ⟦Acts 17:25|Ac 17:25⟧; σοφία, ⟦1 Corinthians 2:13|I Co 2:13⟧; φύσις, ⟦James 3:7|Ja 3:7⟧; κτίσις, ⟦1 Peter 2:13|I Pe 2:13⟧ (MM, VGT, s.v.); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opp. to ἡ ἡμ. (⟦1 Corinthians 3:13|3:13⟧, God's Judgment-Day), ⟪human judgment⟫, ⟦1 Corinthians 4:3|I Co 4:3⟧ (v. Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., ⟪temptation such as man can bear⟫ (AV, such as is common to man, v. Field, Notes, 175), ⟦1 Corinthians 10:13|I Co 10:13⟧; ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, ⟪I speak in human fashion⟫, with words not properly weighed, ⟦Romans 6:19|Ro 6:19⟧ (v. Field, Notes, 156).†
a: Notes on the Translation of the N.T., by F. Field, Camb., 1899

G443.b:
* ⟪ἀνθρωποκτόνος⟫, -ον
(< κτείνω, to kill), ⟪a murderer⟫, ⟪manslayer⟫ (Eur.; v. MM, VGT, s.v.): ⟦John 8:44|Jo 8:44⟧, ⟦1 John 3:15|I Jo 3:15⟧.†
SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (v. Tr., Syn, § lxxxiii).

G444.b:
⟪ἄνθρωπος⟫, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for ⁨אָדָם⁩, ⁨אִישׁ⁩, also for ⁨אֱנוֹשׁ⁩, etc.;] ⟪man⟫:

⟪2.⟫ Indef., ἄ. = τις, ⟪some one⟫, ⟪a man⟫: ⟦Matthew 17:14|Mt 17:14⟧, ⟦Mark 12:1|Mk 12:1⟧, al.; τις ἄ., ⟦Matthew 18:12|Mt 18:12⟧, ⟦John 5:5|Jo 5:5⟧, al.; indef. ⟪one⟫ (Fr. on), ⟦Romans 3:28|Ro 3:28⟧, ⟦Galatians 2:16|Ga 2:16⟧, al.; opp. to women, servants, etc., ⟦Matthew 10:36|Mt 10:36⟧ ⟦Matthew 19:10|19:10⟧, ⟦John 7:22|Jo 7:22⟧, ⟦John 7:23|23⟧.
⟪3.⟫ Definitely, c. art., of some particular person; ⟦Matthew 12:13|Mt 12:13⟧, ⟦Mark 3:5|Mk 3:5⟧, al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., ⟦Luke 14:30|Lk 14:30⟧; ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, ⟦Mark 14:71|Mk 14:71⟧, ⟦Matthew 12:45|Mt 12:45⟧; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, ⟦2 Thessalonians 2:3|II Th 2:3⟧; ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. ⁨אֱלֹהִים⁩ ⁨אִישׁ⁩), ⟦1 Timothy 6:11|I Ti 6:11⟧, ⟦2 Timothy 3:17|II Ti 3:17⟧, ⟦2 Peter 1:21|II Pe 1:21⟧; ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀ., v.s. υἱός.
SYN.: ἀνήρ, q.v. (and cf. MM, VGT, 44; Cremer, 103, 635).

(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for ⁨רפה⁩, ⁨נשׂא⁩, etc.;]
⟪1.⟫ ⟪to send up⟫, ⟪produce⟫, ⟪to send back⟫.
⟪2.⟫ ⟪to let go⟫, leave without support: ⟦Hebrews 13:5|He 13:5⟧ (cf. ⟦Deuteronomy 31:6|De 31:6⟧; Hom., Il., ii, 71).
⟪3.⟫ ⟪to relax⟫, ⟪loosen⟫ (v. Field, Notes, 124 f.): ⟦Acts 16:26|Ac 16:26⟧ ⟦Acts 27:40|27:40⟧; hence, metaph., ⟪to give up⟫, ⟪desist from⟫: ⟦Ephesians 6:9|Eph 6:9⟧.†

G450.b:

⟪1.⟫ causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., c. acc., ⟪to raise up⟫: ⟦Acts 9:41|Ac 9:41⟧; from death, ⟦John 6:39|Jo 6:39⟧, ⟦Acts 2:32|Ac 2:32⟧; ⟪to raise up⟫, ⟪cause to be born or appear⟫: ⟦Matthew 22:24|Mt 22:24⟧, ⟦Acts 3:22|Ac 3:22⟧, ⟦Acts 3:26|26⟧.
⟪2.⟫ Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;
	⟪(a)⟫ ⟪to rise⟫: from lying, ⟦Mark 1:35|Mk 1:35⟧; from sitting, ⟦Luke 4:16|Lk 4:16⟧; to leave a place, ⟦Matthew 9:9|Mt 9:9⟧; pleonastically, as Heb. ⁨קוּם⁩, before verbs of going, ⟦Mark 10:1|Mk 10:1⟧, al.
